name: python-observability
Python structured logging, metrics, tracing, production debugging. Production logs: JSON via `structlog` (`structlog.processors.TimeStamper(fmt="iso")`, `structlog.processors.JSONRenderer()`, `structlog.get_logger()`); human-readable locally. Include consistent filtering/correlation fields. Use `structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars`, `structlog.processors.add_log_level`, `structlog.processors.StackInfoRenderer`, `structlog.processors.format_exc_info`. Levels: `DEBUG` diagnostics, `INFO` lifecycle/operations, `WARNING` recoverable anomalies, `ERROR` failure
